detail.longDescription: Predictors reading a coding agent's transcript mid-run call failure at 0.62 AUROC. The share of 16 other models that failed the same issue gets 0.92. On SWE-bench Verified, the transcript added nothing measurable past difficulty and model. That 0.92 needs outcomes you won't have in production, so the fallback is still reading the run yourself.
